description: On the table in front are several small plastic cups in blue, yellow, red, and green, plus a yellow squeeze bottle and a small blue textured cleaning sponge. The left hand holds the red cup steady while the right hand brings the blue sponge to the cup’s opening, pushes it inside, twists and presses against the inner wall as if scrubbing, then pulls the sponge back out to the right while the left hand keeps the cup in place.
